Many people dealing with fertility issues keep groping in the dark when it comes to their treatment. Of course, the diagnosis has immense emotional and social implications. The distraught couple often finds itself emotionally down while dealing with a social stigma. What follows is a detailed inquiry into the reasons for the condition and then the probable treatment methodologies are identified. The doctor may refer many methods according to the reasons and the age of the couple. IUI and IVF are the most common treatment methods suggested in modern times. IUI treatment guarantees IUI treatment facility to end the infertility problem bothering many couples.

IUI –what is it exactly? IUI is basically a process undertaken in case the problem lies with the sperm motility or sperm count of the male partner while the female partner is in good reproductive health. This process ensures that the sperm reaches the fallopian tubes of the female reproductive system and results in successful fertilization. The procedure's advantages are that it is minimally invasive and requires less recovery time. A 20% success rate is guaranteed per cycle. The age and lifestyle of the couple are also determiners of the success rate. The medical history of the couple also holds an important place in determining the success rate.

The procedure The primary step in the procedure includes the collection of the sperm sample from the male partner or a donor if one is being used. The sample is taken to the lab. Here it is separated from the seminal fluid. The female, on the other hand, is given medication to stimulate her ovulation cycle. The LH hormone level is monitored and the period of ovulation is figured out according to the level of LH hormones. LH hormone shoots up 24-36 hours before the ovulation begins. The day of the IUI is fixed accordingly as this is the most favorable time to conceive. The female is made to lie on the table. Using a catheter, the sperm is inserted directly into the uterus. This procedure elevates the chances of the sperms reaching the eggs at the most favorable time. While some doctors discharge the female after 10 minutes, some recommend that the female lies in the position for an hour more. The procedure doesn't call for any incisions or surgical measures. Though some women might experience discomfort, it is a relatively painless procedure.

How much does the treatment cost? The cost of treatment varies from Rs .300-Rs.800 per cycle. Usually, it takes multiple procedures to achieve a favorable result.

Eligibility criteria The couple who are facing infertility due to low sperm count or low sperm motility can opt for the procedure. Men with ejaculation dysfunction can also opt for this process. Women who have cervical scarring or mucus abnormalities in the cervix will also benefit from the procedure. But the couples in which the female suffers from pelvic inflammatory disease, endometriosis or problem with the fallopian tubes will not benefit from this treatment.

Are there any side effects? Apart from the likelihood of conceiving multiple babies in a single go, there are chances of acquiring an infection.
